---
title: "Mathematica Derivations"
---

The notebooks contain the original derivations of the scattering expressions.
Read the PDF exports without Mathematica, or download a notebook to inspect and
run the symbolic calculations. Historical filenames are preserved.

| Subunit | Read | Download |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gaussian polymer | [PDF](RWpolymer.pdf) | [Notebook](RWpolymer.nb) |
| Gaussian loop | [PDF](RWloop.pdf) | [Notebook](RWloop.nb) |
| Thin rod | [PDF](ThinRod.pdf) | [Notebook](ThinRod.nb) |
| Thin disk | [PDF](ThinDisk.pdf) | [Notebook](ThinDisk.nb) |
| Solid sphere | [PDF](SolidSphere.pdf) | [Notebook](SolidSphere.nb) |
| Solid spherical shell | [PDF](SolidSphericalShell.pdf) | [Notebook](SolidSphericalShell.nb) |
| Solid cylinder | [PDF](SolidCyllinder.pdf) | [Notebook](SolidCyllinder.nb) |

The notebooks retain their original contents, including historical local export
paths. Adjust those paths if regenerating PDFs on another machine.

For the newer axial model, see the [SymPy spheroid derivation](../spheroid/spheroid.qmd).
Numerical sampling validation is maintained separately in `Tests/sampling/` in
the repository.
